label: The output of hidden unit j equals the hyperbolic tangent of the sum of the inputs weighted by the connections into that unit, plus its bias
The output probability equals the logistic sigmoid of the final weighted sum z, which is one over one plus e to the minus z
The squared error loss equals one half times the difference between the predicted probability and the true outcome, squared
The gradient of the loss with respect to any parameter in the network equals the output error times p times one minus p times the derivative of the final sum with respect to that parameter
The gradient descent update sets each new parameter equal to the old parameter minus the learning rate times its gradient
